composition_label: Feedback analysis (Customer insights) -> Semantic search (Smart product search) -> Deep research (Research)

construction.implementation_origin: New implementation written directly in the isolated build directory; no other build or repository files read or copied.

input.synthetic: Required literal true; example data and test fixtures are synthetic.
input.query: Required nonblank string containing non-stopword searchable terms.
input.feedback: 1..1000 records with unique nonblank id and text.
input.documents: 1..1000 records with unique nonblank id, title, text, and optional claims array.
input.claims: 0..100 per document: topic, position (support/oppose/uncertain), and verbatim excerpt contained in that document.
input.limit: Optional integer 1..20, default 5; booleans are not accepted.

shared_schema.success_output: Cumulative envelope containing schema_version, status=ok, synthetic=true, original request, feedback_analysis, semantic_search, and deep_research.
shared_schema.error_output: One JSON object with schema_version, status=error, and error message; exit code 2.
shared_schema.validation: Shared validate_request and validate_state boundaries enforce stage order, closed input fields, exact deterministic output shape and scalar types, original-source excerpts, full index and ranking integrity, theme references and research citations. Stage functions copy inputs and never mutate upstream state.
shared_schema.bounds: Strings are limited to 20000 characters. Embedding vectors are limited to 4096 components. Feedback and document IDs are unique within their respective collections.

cross_stage_handoffs.consumed: Validated deduplicated feedback groups provide feedback expansion terms; validated themes label matching results. The optional embedding query includes the same feedback terms.
Validated ranked document IDs exclusively select research sources. Search ranks and feedback theme IDs propagate to evidence; candidate_count identifies truncated retrieval.

behavior.feedback: Case-folded Unicode word sequences deduplicate punctuation/case variants. All original IDs and exact text excerpts remain available. Multi-label keyword themes report unique-group and raw-record counts; unmatched feedback gets other.
behavior.search: In-memory inverted term-frequency index. Query and deduplicated feedback term matches are retrieved through postings. Lexical score is 0.75 query-term coverage plus 0.25 feedback-term coverage. Scores are rounded to six decimals; positive candidates sort by descending score then document ID.
behavior.optional_embedding: Library run_pipeline(request, embedding=callable) accepts an injected text-to-vector Python callable. Vectors must be numeric, finite, nonzero and dimension-consistent. Stable cosine normalization supports large finite components. Combined score is 0.8 lexical plus 0.2 max(0, cosine). Fixture-only callables were tested; no live provider is configured.
behavior.research: Groups explicitly annotated claims by normalized topic, retains exact evidence and source IDs, reports support/oppose disagreements without deciding truth, and distinguishes within-document from cross-document opposition. Unannotated documents yield a verbatim first-sentence excerpt, capped at 240 characters, labeled observation rather than an invented claim.
behavior.unresolved_questions: Conflicting evidence, single-source topics, explicit uncertainty, unstructured evidence, empty retrieval and retrieval truncation are reported deterministically.
behavior.cli: Exactly one JSON object on stdout. Success exits 0. File, decoding, malformed JSON, duplicate JSON keys, nonfinite JSON constants, usage and validation failures exit 2 with status error.

included: One integrated deterministic pipeline with validated cumulative handoffs
Traceable feedback deduplication and keyword themes
Search index, deterministic ranking and optional fixture-tested embedding injection
Multi-document claim grouping, disagreement detection and unresolved questions
Synthetic example, direct library tests and CLI subprocess tests
excluded: Live providers, network access and third-party packages
Learned semantic model, stemming, synonym inference or fuzzy deduplication
Automatic factual claim extraction, source reliability verification or causal inference
Document independence verification beyond distinct document IDs
Enterprise persistence, authentication, production scaling and deployment

coverage: Each pipeline stage and both cross-stage propagation boundaries
Exact provenance, deduplication, themes, index, ranking and tie breaking
Disagreement, within-document conflicts, uncertainty and unstructured evidence
No matches, top-k truncation, Unicode and immutability
Invalid input, closed fields, duplicate IDs, false excerpts and stage tampering
Embedding success, feedback injection, negative cosine, large finite vectors, malformed vectors, dimensions and callable failure
CLI success, usage, missing file, malformed JSON, invalid schema and duplicate keys
